idea-plugin.name: VT Git Graph
idea-plugin.description: A complete, visual Git graph for IntelliJ IDEA. Browse every branch as a colored commit graph, inspect commits and changed files, and run Git operations directly from the graph: checkout, branch, tag, merge, rebase, interactive rebase, cherry-pick, revert, reset, stash, bisect, worktrees, remotes and submodules.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • Initial release of the commit graph, details panel and Git operations.

action.text: Open VT Git Graph in Editor Tab
action.description: Open the Git graph as a full editor tab
